scope: Supplemental system/software subtype labels for 10 existing emulator rows that had blank subtype metadata after the prior 11-emulators batch. These labels refine identification without upgrading maturity or compatibility claims.

updates.evidence_note: The official site documents AetherSX2 as an Android PlayStation 2 emulator. The existing row already records the shutdown and source-availability caveats; this only fills the missing subtype.
The maintainer page documents Altirra as an Atari 8-bit computer emulator and lists source downloads/builds.
The upstream repository describes AppleWin as an Apple II emulator; its builds target Windows.
The maintainer describes this as a PlayStation 3 emulator and reports very early commercial-game boot support; the subtype preserves its experimental status.
The maintainer describes this as a PlayStation 4 emulator and documents a compatibility list; the subtype preserves its experimental status.

updates.evidence_note: The project page identifies XQEMU as an Xbox and Chihiro emulator built on QEMU and points general users to the xemu fork.

fields.subtype: Closed-source Philips CD-i optical-disc console emulator

updates.evidence_note: The maintainer page identifies the target as Philips CD-i and publishes beta player downloads; the existing row accurately records the lack of public source.

fields.subtype: ColecoVision console and Coleco ADAM home-computer emulator

updates.evidence_note: The maintainer repository describes ADAM+ as an emulator for ColecoVision and Coleco ADAM.
The project site describes NeXium as a Nintendo Switch emulator; early support and project-status wording remain in the existing status and summary fields.

updates.evidence_note: The maintainer describes Pound as an early emulator project for Switch-family software; the subtype labels it as a prototype rather than implying usable compatibility.
